import sys,os,json,time,copy,unittest
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/src/tests/integration')
from test_gateway_context import GatewayContextTests,ContextSink

class Review(unittest.TestCase):
 router=GatewayContextTests.router
 request=GatewayContextTests.request
 configure=staticmethod(GatewayContextTests.configure)
 open_scope=GatewayContextTests.open_scope
 headers=staticmethod(GatewayContextTests.headers)
 event=GatewayContextTests.event
 ingest=GatewayContextTests.ingest
 stream_bytes=staticmethod(GatewayContextTests.stream_bytes)
 stream_events=staticmethod(GatewayContextTests.stream_events)
 def test_stream_shadow_and_explicit_alias(self):
  for mode,second,expected in [('shadow','auto','frontier'),('active','baseline','frontier'),('active','alias','physical')]:
   with self.subTest(mode=mode,second=second):
    def edit(c,s):
     self.configure(c,s,mode);s.RequestHandlerClass=ContextSink;s.stream_wire=self.stream_bytes(self.stream_events())
    with self.router(edit) as (p,sink):
     scope=self.open_scope(p);history=[{'role':'user','content':'start'}]
     body={'model':'auto','messages':history,'max_tokens':128,'stream':True}
     code,raw,_=self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,1));self.assertEqual(code,200);self.assertEqual(raw,sink.stream_wire)
     self.assertEqual(self.ingest(p,self.event(scope,1,1)),202);time.sleep(.25)
     history += [{'role':'assistant','content':'café 🦀'},{'role':'user','content':'continue'}]
     body['model']=second;sink.stream_wire=None
     self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,2))[0],200)
     self.assertEqual(sink.seen[-1][2]['model'],expected)
 def test_more_wire_pins_and_irreversibility(self):
  valid=self.stream_bytes(self.stream_events())
  wires={'early_done':b'data: [DONE]\n\n'+valid,'raw_nul':valid.replace(b'caf',b'ca\x00f'),
         'duplicate_null':valid.replace(b'"finish_reason": null',b'"finish_reason": null,"finish_reason": null',1),
         'unknown_null':valid.replace(b'"delta": {',b'"delta": {"future":null,',1),
         'usage_early':self.stream_bytes([{'choices':[],'usage':{'prompt_tokens':0,'completion_tokens':0,'total_tokens':0}}],False)+valid}
  def edit(c,s):self.configure(c,s);s.RequestHandlerClass=ContextSink
  with self.router(edit) as (p,sink):
   for name,wire in wires.items():
    with self.subTest(name=name):
     status,raw,_=self.request(p,path='/v1/context/open',source=True,body={'task_id':name,'session_id':name,'branch':'b'});self.assertEqual(status,201);scope=json.loads(raw)
     history=[{'role':'user','content':'start'}];body={'model':'baseline','messages':history,'max_tokens':128,'stream':True}
     sink.stream_wire=wire
     code,raw,_=self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,1));self.assertEqual(code,200);self.assertEqual(raw,wire)
     history += [{'role':'assistant','content':'café 🦀'},{'role':'user','content':'continue'}];body['model']='alias'
     self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,2))[0],403)
     body['model']='baseline';sink.stream_wire=valid
     self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,3))[0],200)
     history += [{'role':'assistant','content':'café 🦀'},{'role':'user','content':'again'}];body['model']='alias'
     self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,4))[0],403)
 def test_observer_allocation_failure_preserves_wire_and_pins(self):
  arm=Path('/build/observer-arm');os.environ['SSE_REVIEW_ARM']=str(arm)
  def edit(c,s):self.configure(c,s);s.RequestHandlerClass=ContextSink;s.stream_wire=self.stream_bytes(self.stream_events());s.wire_step=1
  with self.router(edit) as (p,sink):
   scope=self.open_scope(p);arm.touch();history=[{'role':'user','content':'start'}]
   body={'model':'baseline','messages':history,'max_tokens':128,'stream':True}
   code,raw,_=self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,1));self.assertEqual(code,200);self.assertEqual(raw,sink.stream_wire);self.assertFalse(arm.exists(),'fault not injected')
   history += [{'role':'assistant','content':'café 🦀'},{'role':'user','content':'continue'}];body['model']='alias'
   self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,2))[0],403)
   body['model']='baseline'
   self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,3))[0],200)
   history += [{'role':'assistant','content':'café 🦀'},{'role':'user','content':'again'}];body['model']='alias'
   self.assertEqual(self.request(p,body=body,headers=self.headers(scope,4))[0],403)
  del os.environ['SSE_REVIEW_ARM']
